name: Teia Wiki Contract
description: On-chain registry for the Teia community wiki. Each page is identified by an auto-incrementing integer page_id and stores its current IPFS/Arweave CID, a hidden flag and a full, append-only version history (every version keeps its CID, editor, optional proposer and timestamp, queryable via the get_version view). Page names/titles live off-chain in the page's CID content; duplicate-name checks are handled by the UI. Moderators and linked multisig users can create, update and hide pages directly. Teia token holders can submit proposals to edit an existing page (create_proposal) or to create a brand new page (prop_new_page); each proposal action charges its own configurable fee, forwarded to the fee recipient (typically the Teia multisig), and any fee can be set to 0 via governance. A moderator or multisig user approves or rejects pending proposals; a single approval applies the change (creating the page or appending a new version). Multisig governance covers pause, the linked multisig/moderator/token addresses, the token id, per-action fees, the fee recipient and contract metadata updates; governance proposals require a minimum number of votes and expire after a configurable time, both fetched from the linked multisig contract.
